title: Members and invites
subtitle: Remote teams — roles, links, and what syncs
sync.title: What syncs
empty.title: Just you for now
empty.hint: Invite colleagues by link and pick a role before sharing data.
error.title: Couldn't reach the team right now
remote.title: Remote team
remote.subtitle: Share channels with colleagues who use Persona on another computer. DMs, runs and accounts never leave here.
remote.body.none: Connect to share channels with colleagues.
remote.body.connected: New messages in the shared channels flow both ways on their own.
remote.body.offline: New messages are kept and go up when the connection is back.
remote.body.revoked: The team owner ended your access. What was already here stays here.
remote.body.vaultUnavailable: I cannot read the key saved on this computer. Open Persona again; if it continues, see Help.
remote.connect.title: Connect this team
remote.connect.hint: You are the owner. Enter the team address and choose what to share.
remote.connect.addressHint: It is in the team's setup message.
remote.connect.channelsHint: Only new messages from the checked channels. DMs never go up.
remote.invite.role.member: Talks in the shared channels and sees their board.
remote.invite.role.guest: Reads and replies in the shared channels. Cannot invite anyone or change what is shared.
remote.invite.once: The code shows up only now and is not saved anywhere. Send it to the person before closing.
remote.invites.title: Invites
remote.accept.title: Join with an invite
remote.accept.hint: Paste the address and the code you received.
remote.error.vault: Vault unavailable. The remote team only works in the installed app.
remote.error.address: Check the team address (it starts with http:// or https://).
remote.error.channels: Check at least one channel to share.
remote.error.forbidden: Only the owner of this connection can do that.
remote.error.generic: I couldn’t finish that right now. Check the details and try again.
remote.accept.addressHint: Both come together in the invite you received.
remote.revoke.title: End this person's access?
remote.revoke.body: The person stops seeing the shared channels from now on. What they already saw stays with them.
remote.body.offlineAt: New messages are kept and go up when the connection is back. Last exchange {when}.
remote.members.title: People on the team
